value.rationale: Unanimity is a natural symmetric Boolean event and the exact envelope is not a routine restatement of a single-endpoint bound. The result exposes a parity effect at the fair marginal and an even-only central phase in which two endpoints cooperate, while also giving explicit extremizers for every parameter. This supplies a compact boundary fact for limited-independence probability models rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
